_notes.units: USD per 1M tokens. Keyed by chat_models KEY (e.g. opus5.0), not the Bedrock model id.
_notes.cache_write: prompt-cache write. Anthropic: 5-minute TTL. OpenAI: GPT-5.5/5.4 have no cache-creation charge (0); GPT-5.6 bills explicit caching at 1.25x input, 30-minute TTL.
_notes.cached_in_input: true for OpenAI-on-Bedrock: input_tokens already INCLUDES cached input, so the cached portion is billed once at cache_read, never also at the input rate.
_notes.sonnet5: List price matches Sonnet 4.6 ($3/$15). Intro discount ($2/$10) runs through 2026-08-31; we bill list so budget caps stay conservative and need no revert once it ends.
_notes.override: To override or add rates, create pricing.json (gitignored, same folder). Entries there REPLACE these per model key; models you don't list keep the defaults below. There is no silent fallback: a model with no entry bills $0 and logs loudly. Changes apply on server restart.
